data.name: Covert X Universe
data.detailed_description:
Covert X Universe

Covert X Universe is an online anime-inspired sandbox MMO where you can fight, explore, survive, build, tame powerful Battle Pets, travel across planets, and compete against other players across an entire universe.

Explore 9 unique planets and deep space, each filled with dangerous enemies, bosses, resources, challenges, and secrets to discover. Travel from world to world, grow stronger, unlock new races, build bases, form tribes, and create your own path through the universe.

Fight Your Way to the Top

Master fast-paced, real-time anime-inspired combat and take on enemies, bosses, Battle Pets, and other players.

Fight in open-world PvP, enter tournaments, challenge powerful creatures, and push your character to become one of the strongest fighters in the universe.

Explore a Massive Universe

Travel across 9 planets and deep space using a connected planetary system.

Each world offers new places to explore, enemies to fight, resources to gather, bosses to defeat, and challenges to overcome.

Battle Pets

Find and command powerful Battle Pets that can fight alongside you.

Train your pets, take them into battle, and use them against creatures, bosses, and other players.

Build, Survive & Conquer

Gather resources, craft items, build bases and structures, create or join tribes, and survive in a dangerous multiplayer universe.

Your adventure is yours to create—explore, fight, build, compete, or hunt for greater power.

Features

• 9 unique planets to explore
• Deep-space travel across the universe
• 9 starter races and 64 unlockable races
• Fast-paced anime-inspired combat
• Battle Pets that fight alongside you
• Open-world PvP survival gameplay
• Base building and structures
• Resource gathering and crafting
• Tribe and party systems
• Powerful bosses and enemies
• Universe-wide tournaments
• Battle Royale-style competitions
• Character progression and race unlocking
• Reincarnation system
• Text chat and voice chat
• Destructible environments and worlds
• Frequent updates and expanding content

Survival of the Fittest

Covert X Universe is a PvP sandbox where power matters, worlds can become battlegrounds, and only the strongest will rise.

Build your character. Train your Battle Pets. Explore the planets. Challenge other players. Defeat bosses. Conquer the universe.

Active Development

Covert X Universe is actively being developed and expanded.

New content, improvements, balancing, fixes, and features are continually being added. Player feedback is extremely valuable, so please report bugs, connection problems, balance issues, or anything else that can help improve the game.

The universe is growing—and this is only the beginning.

data.short_description: Enter an online multiplayer combat sandbox where players battle on different worlds. Fight, survive, and prove who is strongest

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 4th gen / Ryzen 3 1200 or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / GTX 950 / GTX 1050 or RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / GTX 1650 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
